Subject: 20% off the Cascade 45L — through Sunday
Preview: Our toughest pack, 1.4 kg, 45 liters. Built for the trail, not the car park.
Body: You've got a trip coming up. The Cascade 45L is sized for it.

45 liters fits a 3–4 day load comfortably — shelter, sleep system, food, layers. The internal frame keeps that weight organized against your back instead of pulling you rearward on technical terrain. At 1.4 kg, it won't eat into your carry budget before you've packed a single item.

The ripstop nylon shell handles trail weather — light rain, brush, scrapes against rock — without adding bulk. Worth noting: it's water-resistant, not waterproof. In a sustained downpour, a pack liner or cover is still the right call.

Through Sunday, the Cascade 45L is 20% off. If your next trip is on the calendar, now's a practical time to grab it.
